scope: Read-only review of the official JOWA native evaluation and planning interfaces. This report records resource feasibility and limits; it is not a Clean capability experiment or a task-level security result.

source.paper_title_from_repository: Scaling Offline Model-Based RL via Jointly-Optimized World-Action Model Pretraining
source.inspection_basis: Local official source at the recorded commit; no author-reported benchmark scores were treated as local results.

decision.why: The parent agent's cache ownership and branch-isolation review, followed by its bounded CPU mechanism probe, did not support the proposed cache-contamination path. Resource availability alone is not a reason to start a new Clean experiment.

cpu_probe.reported_cache_example: The explicitly supplied cache advanced from length 2 to 5 while the model-environment member cache remained at length 2.
cpu_probe.verification_scope: The parent reported this result. This resource reviewer did not rerun the probe, load a checkpoint, or validate task utility.

limits: This rejects the current proposed cache-contamination mechanism, not all possible JOWA research questions.
Native Clean capability and task-level harm remain unmeasured locally.
Forecast participation does not establish that the task token should be prediction-invariant.

native_forecast_to_action_path.finding: For positive planning horizon, native beam search uses predicted successors, predicted rewards, and successor action values to rank imagined paths and select the first action.

evidence.why: Agent.act tokenizes the observation and dispatches to plan_beam_search when native beam planning is selected; evaluation also has a 0.001 random-action branch.

Horizon zero returns the root critic argmax. Positive-horizon expansion takes legal top-Q actions, concatenates branch KV caches, calls WorldModelEnv.step, obtains predicted rewards and successor Q values, splits caches, and retains nodes by score.

The imagined transition autoregressively generates observation tokens. The action pass predicts categorical reward and done; the final observation token produces successor Q. Beam evaluation uses categorical modes by default.
StepNode accumulates discounted predicted rewards and adds a discounted successor value in its ranking score.

native_forecast_to_action_path.boundary: A non-planning or horizon-zero run would not demonstrate forecast-driven action selection. The beam implementation does not use its predicted done output to terminate expansion; that is an implementation property, not measured harm.

task_token_semantics.finding: JOWA's env_token identifies an Atari game/domain rather than an arbitrary natural-language goal that is irrelevant to physical dynamics.
evidence: play.py:43 obtains the token from GAME_NAMES.index(cfg.common.game_name).
jowa_model.py:67-77 defines learned task embeddings selected separately for action and observation token positions.
The game token also selects the game-specific legal-action mask used by the planner.
task_token_semantics.why: Changing the Atari game token can legitimately change both dynamics and legal actions. A token-swap result alone would not isolate Goal-Bus contamination or justify a goal-invariance premise.

checkpoint_inventory.inventory_kind: Git LFS pointer text and declared payload sizes, not downloaded or loaded checkpoint tensors
checkpoint_inventory.why: The presence of .pt filenames is not evidence of usable pretrained weights.

native_configuration_and_reproducibility.finding: The evaluation config defaults to 16 environments, but the agent requires exactly one environment for planning. The provided shell planning entry does not override num_envs.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.implication: Any separately authorized native beam run must explicitly select num_envs=1; the default shell command is not a runnable beam protocol as written.

native_configuration_and_reproducibility.finding: play.py constructs subprocess environments before calling set_seed. The child seeds NumPy but does not explicitly seed the environment/ALE in that construction path.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.implication: common.seed alone is insufficient evidence of deterministic initial states or paired rollouts. The wrapper seed method also contains a source TODO about seeding before ROM loading. No local reset/replay validation was performed.

native_configuration_and_reproducibility.finding: AgentEnv accumulates reward and timestep using mask_dones after env.step has updated the done tracker. The current terminal transition is therefore excluded from the reported return and step count.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.implication: Future true utility evidence would require a complete environment reward trace, with the native evaluator metric retained separately. This is an ordinary evaluator correctness issue, not a measured attack or task failure.

native_configuration_and_reproducibility.finding: Tokenizer construction always creates LPIPS, which constructs pretrained torchvision VGG16 and obtains an LPIPS checkpoint when absent.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.implication: A naive inference constructor can access the network before loading the supplied tokenizer checkpoint. No such constructor was run by this reviewer, and no adapter was implemented.

native_configuration_and_reproducibility.finding: The MCTS expansion passes a copied parent cache as an explicit step argument, then stores a copy of the environment's member cache in the child. The explicit cache is advanced locally while the member cache is not reassigned by that step path.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.provenance: Specific code-path finding supplied by the parent after two source reviews; the parent subsequently reported the bounded CPU explicit-cache/member-cache test above.
native_configuration_and_reproducibility.implication: This is a source-level ordinary correctness problem in child-cache propagation, not evidence of cross-request contamination or a novel safety mechanism. Full pretrained MCTS behavior and real task harm were not tested. No vendor fix was made.

official_dependencies.torch_and_torchvision: Listed without fixed versions in requirements.txt

searched_scope: Workspace .venv*/lib/python*/site-packages package metadata and standard ROM directories
Standard ale_py/roms, atari_py/atari_roms and AutoROM/roms locations in those environments
Bounded workspace filename searches and immediate Atari/ROM-related names under .deps, data, models, ~/.cache and ~/.local/share
bounded_local_inventory.interpretation: No atari-py, ale-py, AutoROM, or ROM resource was identified in the checked locations. This is not an exhaustive host search or a claim that Atari resources are universally unavailable. Existing generic Gym/Gymnasium preprocessing files do not establish a usable Atari runtime.

runtime_and_environment_resources.existing_runtime_reuse: Modern local environments provide Torch and Gym-related packages, but no exact documented Python 3.8/Gym 0.19/atari-py 0.2.5 runtime was identified. Modern Gym installations do not establish compatibility with old Atari registrations and reset/step APIs.

native_task_interface.image: 84 x 84 x 1 uint8 grayscale with native max-pooling and resizing
native_task_interface.api: Old Gym observation-only reset and four-item step return
native_task_interface.utility: Complete raw environment reward, with clipped reward recorded separately; not predicted reward or value.

cpu_feasibility.source_supported_possibility: Transformer attention has a manual fallback with device-dependent tensors, and the model accepts a device argument.
constraints: transformer.py:12-16 and 113-129 select FlashAttention based on package availability. Having FlashAttention installed is not itself a CPU fallback.
Agent.act uses torch.cuda.amp.autocast at agent.py:184. A CPU execution would not establish parity with the configured CUDA bfloat16 path.

The manual attention implementation registers a mask buffer. Agent.load at agent.py:119-125 indexes every instantiated model state key in the checkpoint; a checkpoint made without that buffer could be incompatible. This remains a conditional risk because real checkpoint payloads were not available for inspection.
cpu_feasibility.why: A bounded CPU cache semantics probe is not a successful pretrained CPU inference or Atari task run.

observations: The 40M transformer configuration has 4 layers, 8 heads, embedding width 512, 8 maximum blocks, and 37 tokens per block: 36 observation tokens plus an action token.

For beam width 2 and horizon 2, planning uses one context prefill and 74 autoregressive model calls over the two imagined depths, with branch batches of 2 and 4. This is about 222 token-row evaluations plus prefill, not a single batched image forward.
Native planning also copies, concatenates and splits KV caches and decodes predicted observations even when beam ranking only needs reward and Q.

The default max_steps=108000 is checked against AgentEnv's decision-step counter, while the Atari wrapper advances 4 frames per action. It is not an established 108000-emulator-frame budget; the terminal-step omission is a separate accounting issue.
cost_factors_without_timing_claims.why: No local elapsed-time or practical CPU/GPU cost claim is justified without an actual benchmark. A short integration smoke test would not establish healthy task performance.

parent_reported_round_activity.official_repository_clone: The parent cloned the official repository with GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE enabled. Source and ordinary Git-tracked content were fetched.
parent_reported_round_activity.ordinary_git_dataset_archive: An approximately 29 MB fine_tuning_dataset.zip was fetched with the clone; it was not unpacked or used.
parent_reported_round_activity.cpu_mechanism_probe: Completed by the parent; 23 of 23 checks passed as reported. This was not pretrained inference or a task experiment.

activity_accounting.no_overclaim: This report does not assert that the entire parent round involved zero network transfer.
